metadata.title: TechToJob — Developer and tech company community
metadata.description: Connect with real tech opportunities. Publish your profile, find talent, and participate in development tournaments in Spanish.

hero.title: The <teal>developer</teal> community that connects with <teal>tech companies</teal>
hero.description: Join projects, tournaments, and networking channels within our Discord. Show what you can do, build experience, and create connections so that IT job opportunities find you.

step1.title: 1. Join the community
step1.description: Join Discord instantly without registration forms. Explore channels, projects, and conversations that interest you most.

step2.title: 2. Participate and showcase your skills
step2.description: Share your projects, solve challenges, join tournaments, and take part in community conversations.

step3.title: 3. Let your work speak for you
step3.description: Your participation showcases how you work and what you can do. You don't need to wait for a job opening to start getting noticed.

step4.title: 4. Opportunities appear
step4.description: When a company searches for a profile like yours, they can find you within the community, see your work, and reach out directly.
